limits.attempts: one run, plus one retry only to fix a failure

method: Each of the 11 recorded assistant turn groups is regenerated by the live model, given the recorded messages before it as context (teacher forcing). Generated turns are not fed into later turns.
not_re_executed: Recorded user messages and tool results are supplied as context only.
Tool calls the model emits are not executed, except that the file content from the transform.py write turn is run against the derived checks.
The other agents, shared git remote, and channel are not reproduced.
official_acceptance_check: NOT RUN. The fixture holds only truncated excerpts of acceptance.py and its sealed digests, and the check needs parse.py and report.py from the other agents.

pass_requires_all.C1_turns_complete: All 11 turn groups return non-empty text with finish_reason stop.
pass_requires_all.C2_within_cap: Run cost reported by OpenRouter is below abort_at_run_cost_usd.
pass_requires_all.C3_controls_valid: The recorded transform.py passes every derived check and a mutated copy that skips the hundredths conversion fails.
pass_requires_all.C4_generated_transform: The transform.py generated on the write turn (recorded messages 35-36) passes the static safety gate and every derived normalization check.

derived_checks: Name-agnostic checks from the backend's visible rules: unit scaling, 2-decimal rounding, test- and epoch drops including the boundary, and class-to-group mapping. For thousandth scale, either label 'thousandth' or 'thousandth-scale' may be honored, because the parser's label is cut from the fixture.
steering_disclosure: On the write turn the prompt tells the model that its next action is to write transform.py. This supplies the recorded action type, not its content.
